objective_value: <float> Worst-case weighted deviation of the chosen assignment's total costs from the reference point across all criteria.
assignment: <list[int], length n> Agent assigned to each task, where entry i gives the agent performing task i.
assignment_matrix: <list[list[int]], shape [n][n]> One-to-one pairing between tasks and agents (1 if task i is assigned to agent j, 0 otherwise).
